headline: US Tech Stocks Recover Following Sharp Sell-Off After Midterms
summary: US AI and technology stocks bounced back on Friday, trimming earlier weekly losses after a steep sell-off triggered by concerns over data center projects following the midterm elections.
why: Major shifts in congressional control can alter regulatory expectations and subsidies for capital-intensive sectors like artificial intelligence and tech infrastructure.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: The tech-heavy index experienced sharp volatility and a subsequent bounce following political and sector-specific concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding political shifts in Congress and data center regulatory outlook triggered heavy selling before a late recovery.
